Click this button ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp126-img3.png) to open Measurement tool tool.
The Measurement Tool allows users to calculate spatial properties. It provides three measurement modes: Distance, Area, and Offset.
![Image p127](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp127-img1.png)
3.1.12.1 Distance
Measure the distance between two or more points.
![Image p127](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp127-img2.png)
Click once to finish line segment. Double click to finish drawing.
**Segment lengths**
**Total distance**
Total length of all line segments.
**Segment X**
Shows the length of the line segment.
**Angles**
**Segment 1 → 2**
Angles between line segments.
3.1.12.2 Area
Calculates the surface area and perimeter of the area.
![Image p128](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp128-img1.png)
**Area**
Total enclosed surface.
**Perimeter**
Total boundary length.
3.1.12.3 Offset
Helps find the shortest distance from a line to a point on the map.
![Image p129](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp129-img1.png)
Click once to start drawing the reference line, then once again – to finish. Then, click on the map to select the offset point, towards which you would like the find the distance.
**Distance from segment**
Distance from the line segment to the offset point.
3.1.12.4 Point
![Image p129](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp129-img2.png)
**Coordinates**
To display the coordinates, click on your desired location on the map.
